metadata.description: Capxul Agent Team — a cohesive plugin ecosystem for managing Capxul's AI agent workforce. 9 vertical plugins providing shared skills and commands, plus 6 agent plugins with specialized agent definitions.

plugins.name: infra
plugins.description: Agent infrastructure: onboarding, MCP setup, env materialization from Bitwarden, per-repo config bootstrapping.

plugins.name: pm-core
plugins.description: Linear epic planning, PM reporting, and agent orchestration.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: PR lifecycle, code review, and TypeScript best practices.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security scanning, vulnerability validation, and threat modeling.

plugins.name: evidence-capture
plugins.description: Demo recording, verification, QA testing, and video composition with Remotion.

plugins.name: documentation
plugins.description: Wiki generation, humanized writing, and visual design.

plugins.name: debugging
plugins.description: Browser navigation, frontend debugging, API interception, and skill creation.

plugins.name: observability
plugins.description: PostHog-backed runtime observability: error tracking, analytics, logs, session replay, feature flags, SDK diagnostics, and production evidence for debugging.

plugins.name: epic-conductor
plugins.description: Master controller agent that orchestrates the team, plans epics, and routes work.

plugins.name: implementer
plugins.description: Implements features, manages PR lifecycle, and ensures code quality.

plugins.name: analyst
plugins.description: Security scanning, threat modeling, and deep-dive analysis.

plugins.name: qa-capture
plugins.description: Records demos, verifies claims, runs QA flows, and captures evidence.

plugins.name: debug-guru
plugins.description: Debugs APIs, navigates browsers, designs frontends, and creates skills.

plugins.name: observability-analyst
plugins.description: Runtime evidence specialist for PostHog-backed debugging, analytics, error tracking, feature flags, logs, traces, and session replay.
